title: Social Networking Event in Vienna, Oct 6
html:
Wednesday evening, October 6, 2010, just after release of version 3.1.0, some of us will go out for a dinner in Vienna, Austria. As usual, we make sure the place has good beer to have a fruitful discussion about Kamailio, SER, SIP, VoIP, life and more…

If it happens to be around and you want to join, send an email to miconda (at) gmail.com. Participation is free, on the same policy like previous similar meetings: everyone carries for himself/herself.

Among participants will be:

  • Andreas Granig
  • Daniel-Constantin Mierla
  • Jon Bonilla
  • Klaus Darilion

Looking forward to meet you there!
